item.title: There’s something in the water: The truth about ‘code brown’ events at public pools
item.description: Nothing ruins a nice summery dip like poo in the pool. So how common is it, what’s the clean-up protocol, and is it on the rise? item.title: The Friday Poem: ‘Commentary’ by Megan Clayton
item.description: A new poem by Megan Clayton. Commentary It is hard to talk about this, my love, and so I talk about cricket. What I like is the fourth day of a test match, when everyone is playing for a draw. I like the draw. I like to see defensive play extend the innings. I like a partnership whose aim is not to get out. See the night watchman scoring singles to avoid the facing bowlers! Why, the jeering of the crowd is barely audible! A good way to spend a morning. A good partnership, I say. The Friday Poem
